description: This file defines the CartItem class used to represent an item in a shopping cart, including serialization and deserialization methods, and references an external Book model.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart including the Book object and quantity, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: lineTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates total price for this cart item in cents.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the CartItem to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CartItem instance from a JSON map.
